matching_rule: Exact strings; no trimming, normalization, numeric conversion, fuzzy join or duplicate pairing.
record_number_rule: CSV records, header=1; quoted multiline fields remain one record, not physical line numbers.
encoding: UTF-8 with optional BOM, comma-delimited CSV.
privacy: Reports contain selected source values and keys. They are not anonymized.
csv_cell_protection: Potential formula keys are prefixed with an apostrophe in comparison.csv. comparison.json retains exact strings.
